title: Yellowed Aromatic Moroccan Rice Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic Moroccan dish featuring herbal and flaky rice, perfect for a plant-based dinner, this tagine showcases the beauty of Arabic rice with roasted vegetables.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the chopped carrots and zucchini, and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the cumin, paprika, turmeric, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the Arabic rice to the saucepan, and stir to coat the rice with the oil and spice mixture.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the water is absorbed and the rice is tender.
Remove the saucepan from the heat, and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
